title: Data Collection
content: Payvay collects personal data necessary for providing its services, including identification and contact information.

title: Data Usage
content: Your personal data is used to facilitate transactions, comply with legal obligations, and improve Payvay's services.

title: Data Sharing
content: Personal data may be shared with third parties on a confidential basis for purposes related to the use of the Payvay Platform and services.

title: Data Protection
content: Payvay implements industry-standard security measures to safeguard your personal data.

title: User Rights
content: You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data in accordance with applicable laws.
